title: Confounding Compounding
coreMove: Protect uninterrupted time so small advantages can become large without drama.
sourcePressure: Compounding is hard to grasp because duration matters more than brilliance and results look absurd only after enough time passes.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Presenting compounding as a magic trick or a get-rich formula.
